Two additions originated in the social round: a WeChat explainer syndicated by 新浪财经 on 2026-11-02 resolved to arXiv 2610.20951 (LEV, looped decision models; closed Jev 1.13.0 as a reference), and the exact-title follow-up of the carried-over ResearchGate lead returned arXiv 2610.31315, which turned out to be a different, uncatalogued paper (TUM 'The Value of System 1 Models in Medicine', Jev 1.14 among four System 1 models on 86 clinical tasks). Both had been invisible to every API sweep because their abstracts use 'decision models', 'System 1' or 'JevBench' rather than the standing query tokens. Formal evidence for both comes from the arXiv Atom metadata, abstracts and LaTeXML full text.
